text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf takes the lead!
Standing alone at the absolute pinnacle with no one to rival her!
Symboli Rudolfff—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooooo!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... That was truly incredible.
The moment she lowered her stance, it was over in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So this is the dynamic camera angle.
This is the scenery seen by the "Emperor," Symboli Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: What should we write for the report? For countermeasures, all I can write is 'I felt there's no way to win'~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...The wall is high. But it's not an impossible impasse!
Let's brainstorm together later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Soooo heavy! Gentildonna-san trains with iron balls like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Eye-chan, you can lift that?! Uwaah... Even for horse girls, that's insanely tough~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still, it's hard to properly train at this weight. ...Maybe if I build up to it in ten progressive steps, I can do it?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! Ramonu-senpai's race is playing!
Haaah... Seriously, our upperclassmen are just amazing.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I want to run alongside them soon.
I want to run like that too—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. No, nothing!
Just thinking how amazing you are too, Eye-chan.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Right! You're our rising star!
At this rate, the upcoming event is bound to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A certain day. At Tokyo Racecourse,
a PR event for the Twinkle Series was taking place.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: —Now then, let us hear today's enthusiasm from the runners!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A foolish question.
"Victory." What else could there possibly be?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No shortage of worthy opponents.
I shall display an imposing run befitting the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, isn't this race packed with only the absolute strongest? Who's gonna win?

text_block_list.name: Rudolf Fan
text_block_list.text:
That'd be our "Emperor," of course!
Did you see that dynamic camera footage?! In the end, the first generation reigns supreme~.

text_block_list.name: Ramonu Fan
text_block_list.text:
That "Emperor" will end up kneeling before the "Queen."
Her love for racing is fierce enough to melt even an "Emperor"!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, it'd feel strange no matter who loses.
...By the way. Will that girl be all right?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Almond Eye! Generation-wise, she's their junior.
Wonder how the gap in experience will play out...
choice_data_list: (The difference in experience is certainly there—but...)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Almond Eye-san!
With the strongest upperclassmen as your opponents, what are your thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Of course, I will win!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Oooh...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Compared to my senpais, my skill is still far from sufficient.
However—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Eye will not stop running until she wins.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even against the strongest upperclassmen,
I will definitely show you that I can win.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Surpassing the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Surpassing the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The one who wins in the end and stands smiling will be me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Fan A
text_block_list.text: So if you just keep trying until you succeed, you will succeed! Wahaha! Go get 'em, Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Fan B
text_block_list.text: Such youthful fighting spirit! But yeah, I don't dislike it! In fact, I love it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let me keep challenging you until I win!
Please!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. But my master is even more amazing, you know?
It will still take me quite some time to surpass him.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until she wins, and even after she wins, there is no end in sight.
She never gives up in defeat, and even in victory, she seeks yet further triumph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If left unchecked, just how far will she go?
...Doesn't that terrify everyone?
choice_data_list: Look at Symboli Rudolf and the others' reactions

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Eclipse first, the rest nowhere."
...Words truly made for someone like you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which is precisely why I shall stand in your path.
Believing that demonstrating true strength is also my way of aiding you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you, Student Council President Rudolf.
—I shall surpass you without holding back!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
A dream race where the various strongest gather.
Will the one who seizes victory be a living legend, or a brand new wind?

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst thunderous cheers, the race foreshadowing a whole new chapter
—has just begun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How delightfully foolish.
Quite adorable.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
First, prove your strength.
Words without power behind them are no different than dead leaves.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
—Because I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A dream race bringing together various types of the strongest.
Will victory be claimed by the legends, or by a new wind?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Amid roaring cheers, the race that foreshadows a brand-new chapter—
—has just begun!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Eye~! Do your best~!
Buu and the others are right behind you~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You're representing our whole generation, ya know!
Don't go losing without giving it everything~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
! Fufu!
—Yes! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A dream race bringing together various types of the strongest.
Will victory be claimed by the legends, or by a new wind?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Amid roaring cheers, the race that foreshadows a brand-new chapter—
—has just begun!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Fan B
text_block_list.text:
...Still, sure would be nice if that really happened.
I wanna see it live—the birth of a new legend!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A dream race bringing together various types of the strongest.
Will victory be claimed by the legends, or by a new wind?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Amid roaring cheers, the race that foreshadows a brand-new chapter—
—has just begun!
